claims: RAF 7 (Real American Freestyle) took place on March 28, 2026, in Tampa, FL.
RAF 7 was headlined by Arman Tsarukyan defeating Georgio Poullas.
Colby Covington technical-falled Dillon Danis in the co-main event of RAF 7.
Kyle Dake won a title match at RAF 7.
Kyle Snyder won a title match at RAF 7.
